convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load ColorX2MA_Digit custom indicator, plus two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic. Signal logic depends on custom indicator buffer values (0,1,2) rather than built-in indicators.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec (bar duration in seconds)
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen timing

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input flags control whether opposite-signal closes are enabled; when SellPosClose=true, a buy signal (Value[1]==0, Value[0]<2) closes sell positions; when BuyPosClose=true, a sell signal (Value[1]==2, Value[0]>0) closes buy positions

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot, FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of respective margin/balance metric. MM parameter interpretation depends on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic reads ColorX2MA_Digit buffer 1 (color/trend state buffer) at SignalBar and SignalBar+1 offsets. Buffer values: 0=bullish trend, 1=neutral/transitional, 2=bearish trend. Long entry: Value[1]==0 (was bullish) AND Value[0]>0 (transition from bullish). Short entry: Value[1]==2 (was bearish) AND Value[0]<2 (transition from bearish). The SignalBar input (default=1) means signals are evaluated on the previous closed bar, not the current forming bar. When SignalBar==0, the EA evaluates on every tick instead of only on new bars. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans independently gate each of the four trade actions. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions which handle position checks internally.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of: (1) the entire ColorX2MA_Digit custom indicator which uses 9+ smoothing methods from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA), (2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory), (3) custom Applied_price_ enum with 11 price types beyond standard OHLC. The signal logic itself is simple (buffer value transitions) but the indicator computation is complex. Python conversion should: replicate ColorX2MA_Digit indicator logic first as a standalone function, use the buffer[1]==0 && buffer[0]>0 pattern for longs and buffer[1]==2 && buffer[0]<2 for shorts, implement MarginMode-based position sizing with 5 modes, and ensure SignalBar offset is respected (default=1 means use previous closed bar data). SL/TP values (1000/2000) appear to be in points not pips - verify whether 5-digit adjustment is needed at runtime.
